claims.claim: Analog Devices fiscal Q3 2026 revenue reached a record $4.02B, up 40% YoY, led by Data Center and Industrial; Industrial revenue rose 53% and Communications 84%.
Trailing-12-month operating cash flow was $5.5B and free cash flow $4.9B, or 40% and 36% of revenue, indicating strong cash conversion during the demand acceleration.

risks.risk: Analog/industrial demand can be cyclical and current growth rates may include recovery from a depressed comparison base.

unknowns.unknown: Organic contribution by specific AI/data-center products is not isolated in this artifact.

claims.claim: Execution is strong across both growth and cash conversion, with record revenue and 36% trailing free-cash-flow margin.
The expectation test is persistence: Industrial and Communications growth must remain durable as inventory normalization and cyclical recovery mature.

risks.risk: Recovery-driven comparisons can overstate steady-state growth if end-market normalization fades.

unknowns.unknown: Current valuation and inventory-channel normalization are not established here.
